items.title: Pay private medical invoice
items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum unter Angabe der Rechnungsnummer.
items.computation: This is a private invoice from a doctor's practice (not a public authority), so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the invoice's own date. Invoice date: Friday 26.06.2026. Under §187(1) BGB the day of the event itself is not counted, so counting starts 27.06.2026. 30 days later (§188(1) BGB) lands on Sunday 26.07.2026. Since the last day falls on a Sunday, under §193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 27.07.2026.

warnings: The IBAN (DE53 3705 0198 0006 5544 30, Musterbank AG) is a validly formatted German IBAN, but as with any invoice the account holder's name should still be checked against the practice before paying.
